top_signals.title: Canadian Natural to Buy Advantage Energy Amid Oil Price Boom
top_signals.summary: Canadian Natural Resources agreed to acquire Advantage Energy Ltd. for C$2.255 billion ($1.6 billion), adding to a string of deals in the country’s oil and gas industry as conflicts in the Middle East and Ukraine boost demand for alternative supplies.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: South Africa’s Rand Tests 17 Per Dollar With Focus on Politics
top_signals.summary: The rand weakened toward 17 per dollar as investors fretted about the stability of South Africa’s coalition government, and expectations of a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike next month bolstered the dollar.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
